From \Cref{lemma:araki_uhlmann} and \Cref{lemma:entropy_flux}, the relative
entropy equals the horizon energy flux \eqref{eq:entropy_flux}, proving
\eqref{eq:dm_flux}.

With the above in mind, we are now ready to prove the main statement:

\begin{proof}[Proof of \Cref{theorem:dorau_much}]
The metric-perturbation ansatz yields
$\delta\mathcal{A} = (\alpha/2\pi) \, S^{\mathrm{rel}}(\omega_0\|\omega_\phi)$,
since \eqref{eq:entropy_flux} gives
$\delta\mathcal{A} = -\alpha\int U\langle{:}T_{ab}{:}\rangle$.
The horizon energy flux is thus proportional to the area variation,
$\delta Q \propto \delta\mathcal{A}$.
By \Cref{lemma:thermo_step},
\begin{equation}
\alpha \, \langle {:}T_{ab}{:} \rangle_{\omega_\phi} \, \xi^a \xi^b
= R_{ab} \, \xi^a \xi^b \qquad \text{for all null } \xi^a,
\end{equation}
i.e.\ $\alpha\langle{:}T_{ab}{:}\rangle = R_{ab} + N g_{ab}$ for some function
$N$; conservation and the contracted Bianchi identity give
$N = -\tfrac{1}{2}R + \Lambda$ with $\Lambda$ constant. Hence
\begin{equation}
R_{ab} - \tfrac{1}{2} R g_{ab} + \Lambda g_{ab}
= \alpha \, \langle {:}T_{ab}{:} \rangle_{\omega_\phi},
\end{equation}
with $\alpha = 8\pi$ under $S^{\mathrm{rel}} = \delta\mathcal{A}/4$,
i.e.\ \eqref{eq:dm_einstein}.
Inputs assumed rather than derived: the entropy-area proportionality, the
restriction to coherent states (\Cref{lemma:araki_uhlmann}), and the Killing
horizon itself.
\end{proof}
